prompt.es: Explica una costumbre de tu familia: origen, pasos, dos expresiones y sentimiento.

answer.text: Every year, our family gathers for a big dinner on the last night of December. As far as I know, the custom is very old. First we cook together, and that is not a piece of cake. Then we eat, and finally we sing. That night we are all in the same boat, because nobody can leave the kitchen. In other countries people eat earlier, but we eat at midnight. I feel proud of my family.
accepted: Every year, our family gathers for a big dinner on the last night of December. As far as I know, the custom is very old. First we cook together, and that is not a piece of cake. I feel proud of my family.

Every year, our family gathers for a big dinner on the last night of December. It is said that the custom is very old. First we cook together, and that is not a piece of cake. Every year my family gathers for dinner on the last night of December. As far as I know, it is a very old custom. First we cook together, then we eat and sing. It is not a piece of cake, but I feel proud. In other countries people eat earlier, whereas we eat at midnight.
